thread:
sophia_prod: Quick live thread from today's all-hands Q&A 1: capture concrete customer win/loss patterns and the top asks we should action. I'll drop a short synthesis and people can add clarifying notes or quote snippets.

jamie_sales: TL;DR from deals this quarter: Win - NovaHealth (chose us for latency + pilot results), Loss - DataForge (chose vendor Y for cheaper committed pricing + native Snowflake connector), Pushback - LegalWorks paused on KMS details.

tara_pm: From product POV patterns: 1) customers increasingly ask for "time-to-first-query" docs + runnable demos, 2) connector gaps (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) show up a lot, 3) pricing predictability for Dedicated is a frequent blocker.

kyle_research: adding bench notes: NovaHealth's win came down to consistent 50ms p95 in our hosted trials vs competitor at ~120ms. They also liked our model versioning/rollout controls.

li_cto: relevant engineering notes: our p95 edge case comes from small-batch cold starts for chat sessions; we're working on a fast-warmup path (ENG-5555). Can also add a sample warmup script for customers as a bridge.

elaine_support: LegalWorks asked very specific KMS + audit log latency questions. They want a matrix showing which controls are available for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Current doc is high-level.

ben_devrel: suggestion: ship two artifacts this sprint: (A) "Time-to-first-query" demo repo (single command to run a POC backed by sample data + Snowflake connector stub) (B) "SI enablement kit" with migration templates and a named checklist for PS handoffs.

jamie_sales: +1 from sales. Also ask for a one-slide buyer-facing "migration timeline" that shows a 3-week path with checkpoints. Procurement loves timelines.

sophia_prod: priority votes from the all-hands: 1) Demo repo + runnable POC, 2) Connector backlog triage (Snowflake, BigQuery priority), 3) KMS/compliance matrix + audit examples, 4) Short pricing FAQ for Dedicated commitments. Anything to reorder?

kyle_research: can we include a small benchmark harness in the demo repo so sales can reproduce latency numbers? A script that runs a set of queries and produces p50/p95/p99.

ben_devrel: yes, will include an automated perf script and a README with expected baselines.

li_cto: for connector work: engineering needs clear API contract & telemetry expectations. PM to prioritize which connectors get first-class support vs example connectors.

tara_pm: I've created ticket PM-762 to scope connector priority and feature gates. Will post details in follow-up.

elaine_support: for KMS: I'll draft a "Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private: security controls" doc and include sample audit log payloads and a template BYOK (bring-your-own-KMS) attestation. Might need Legal review but can be draft.

ops_bot: Note: ENG-5555 (fast-warmup) created and linked. QA window tentatively 2289002000.

jamie_sales: quick quote from DataForge: "We needed a Snowflake connector and a fixed monthly rate to fit our budget." Happy to paste email thread to PMs.

sophia_prod: if sales can paste real quote language that's great. We should avoid abstractions in docs.

kyle_research: another win signal from NovaHealth: they flagged our "rollout with traffic shaping" feature as critical 1 helped them mitigate model regressions during POC. Suggest we highlight rollout controls in demo.

ben_devrel: will add an example that shows a canary rollout and rollback script.

tara_pm: action owners I'm proposing: Demo repo + benchmark harness (owner: devrel, ticket DEVREL-890), Connector triage & backlog (owner: product, ticket PM-762), KMS/compliance matrix (owner: support/docs, ticket DOCS-334), Pricing FAQ + commitment tiers (owner: finance/product, ticket PRIC-21). Agree?

li_cto: agree. Also recommend a short "stopgap" doc listing recommended Dedicated configs for customers running chat workloads until fast-warmup lands.

elaine_support: noted. Also flagging LegalWorks follow-up for audit logs: creating support case template for them.

jamie_sales: sales asks: can we get a short PS proposal template (scope + price band) so sales can offer white-glove migration? Many customers expect a PS contact.

sophia_prod: good point. Let's add PS template to the SI enablement kit.

ben_devrel: I'll spin up the demo repo draft and link a staging preview by 2289001800. Repo will include Snowflake connector stub and BigQuery sample.

ops_bot: Reminder: link created for ENG-5555 and DEVREL-890.

kyle_research: one more datapoint: some customers are sensitive to "unit token pricing" surprises. Can we produce a simple calculator (spreadsheet + CLI) for projected monthly cost given qps/avg tokens?

sophia_prod: excellent idea. Add cost calculator to PRIC-21. Finance, please help.

tara_pm: I'll synthesize notes and paste a short executive summary back into this thread by EOD so leadership can share.

jamie_sales: FYI 1 I'll paste the DataForge email quote and NovaHealth short testimonial into the ticket.

sophia_prod: thanks everyone. Quick requests: drop one-line status updates as you make progress here so we can close loops. We'll review at next all-hands. :white_check_mark:
